summary.text: Chris Judy is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 83 who has represented the district since 2014 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He is a veteran of the Indiana National Guard and a licensed insurance broker.
The other candidate on the general election ballot is Wesley Haffenden, the Democratic nominee.

paragraphs.text: Judy was born in Wabash, Indiana, spent most of his youth in Whitley County and graduated from Manchester High School.
He is a veteran of the Indiana National Guard and served in Iraq in 2008 as a combat medic, and afterward worked as a licensed life and health insurance broker.
He was appointed to the Indiana House on September 22, 2014.
